subject: Science
description: A theory lesson about how water moves in nature.

lines.text: Water changes its form again and again in nature.
lines.explanation: Paani nature mein baar-baar shape change karta hai.

lines.text: The Sun heats water and turns it into vapour.
lines.explanation: Suraj garam karke water ko vapour banata hai.

lines.text: Clouds form when vapour cools down in the sky.
lines.explanation: Vapour thanda hokar clouds ban jata hai.

lines.hint: Say the last line in simple words.

lines.text: Rain brings water back to the earth.
lines.explanation: Barish phir se water ko earth par laati hai.
